records.title: Reforms in Public Sector Banks
details: a to b: Further, IBA has apprised that metrics of EASE 9.0 Reforms Agenda are under formulation and will be rolled out to PSBs by April 2026.

records.title: Development of Nuclear Power Plants by NTPC
details: NTPC Ltd, a CPSE under the administrative control of Ministry of Power, Government of India, has been exploring various options to diversify its energy portfolio, including the possibility of developing nuclear power projects in different States.

records.title: Extension of Humsafar Express (Chennai-Ahmedabad) to Hisar
details: a to d: DPR preparation work has been taken up for construction of Road Over Bridge (ROB) / Road Under Bridge (RUB) in lieu of Level Crossing (LC) No. 86 (Satrod Kalan Railway Crossing) at Km 132/6-7 on Hisar-Bathinda section.

records.title: Technology based crop assessment system under PMFBY.
details: c to d: A complaint from a farmers' organization named "Akhil Bhartiya Kisan Sabha" was received by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare against the settlement of Cotton crop claims in Bhiwani and Charkhi Dadri district using the Technology based Yield estimates. On the basis of the complaint and as per provisions of scheme guidelines, State Government has been advised to take necessary action in the matter.
